content.text:
The pricing page is fixed on phones. The three plan cards now stack in one column at 720px and below. Before, they stayed in three columns and made the page 486px wide on a 390px screen.

I added `.plans` to the existing mobile rule in `site/css/pages.css`. After the change, the visual tests (desktop and phone) and the functional tests all pass, 28 in total. The visual tests include the approved phone screenshot of the pricing page, which failed before the fix.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
